title: Review Result
description: Shared result for plan review, audit, and code review. Findings carry stable semantic keys so repeated rounds merge instead of duplicating.
$comment: Strict structured output requires every property to appear in required at every level. Optional fields are expressed as nullable, never omitted from required. Adding a property without adding it to required makes the Codex backend fail with HTTP 400.

verdict.description: approved requires zero open blocker findings. blocked means work is required before delivery.

subjectHash.description: SHA-256 of the exact subject reviewed, which must equal the handoff's snapshotHash. The subject depends on mode: for plan-check it is the plan, so snapshotHash carries the plan hash; for audit it is the repository tree; otherwise it is the Review Subject diff.

taskId.description: The task this review covers, copied from the handoff. Findings are keyed by taskId plus finding id, so two parallel tasks that independently produce the same semantic key stay distinct. Null for whole-subject reviews.

lensOutcomes.description: One entry per lens the reviewer was responsible for. Without this, a lens that was skipped and a lens that found nothing produce identical output, and approval trusts silence.

outcome.description: passed means examined and clean. caveat means examined with non-blocking findings. not-applicable means the changed surface does not touch this lens, and requires a reason.

reason.description: Why this lens does not apply. Must be a string when outcome is not-applicable; null otherwise.

findings.description: Open findings after this round. A finding already fixed belongs in resolvedFindingIds, not here.

id.description: Stable semantic key derived from the defect, not from its position in the list. Same defect keeps the same id across rounds.

severity.description: blocker prevents delivery. major and minor do not.

evidence.description: Path with line range plus the concrete failure. A finding without evidence is not reportable.

correction.description: The minimal change that closes this finding.

resolvedFindingIds.description: Previously open findings this round confirms closed.

notReproducibleFindingIds.description: Previously open findings this round could not reproduce against the current subject.
